items.enrichment: Single dispatch post so far; neither the hospital nor the department has posted a follow-up.
items.headline: Natural gas odor reported at Massena Hospital ER entrance

updates.text: Fire crews remained on scene at the ER entrance; hospital operations continued while the exterior was checked.

items.what: Massena Fire was called for the smell of natural gas outside the emergency room entrance at Massena Hospital.
items.why: Not yet known. Crews were checking the exterior of the building; no source was confirmed in the initial dispatch.

items.enrichment: No injuries and no road closure were reported.
items.headline: Car vs. deer on CR 38, Norfolk
items.what: A vehicle struck a deer at 581 CR 38 in Norfolk. No injuries were reported in the post.
items.why: Deer movement peaks after dark in November; CR 38 is a known crossing stretch.

items.enrichment: Reported by one scanner group so far; no blotter item or second report has confirmed the call yet.
items.headline: Threat reported on Tucker Rd, Pierrepont
items.what: A caller reported an individual threatening to burn a house down at 206 Tucker Rd; people were gathered out front when the call came in.
items.why: Not yet known. The dispatch post gives no background on the dispute.

items.enrichment: Reported by the county's news source of record; full margin detail arrives with the board of elections canvass.
items.headline: NY-21 congressional race called for Constantino
items.what: North Country Now reported the NY-21 House race called, keeping the seat Republican as statewide results came in on election night.
items.why: Election Day. The call closes the county's most-watched race of the cycle.

items.enrichment: Reported by local news the same day.
items.headline: Benefit concert raises $8,000 for North Country Children's Museum
items.what: A benefit concert raised $8,000 for the North Country Children's Museum in Potsdam.
items.why: Fundraising for the museum's programs; the total was reported by local news the same day.

items.enrichment: Library events are free unless the listing says otherwise.
items.headline: Crane Jazz Ensembles at Potsdam Library
items.what: Crane School of Music jazz ensembles perform at the Potsdam Public Library this evening.
items.who: Crane School of Music, SUNY Potsdam
items.why: A standing community performance series pairing Crane ensembles with the public library.

items.enrichment: Puck drop 7:00 PM. Expect heavier traffic on NY-11 and around the Clarkson campus from about 6 PM.
items.headline: Clarkson men's hockey vs. Union at Cheel
items.what: Clarkson hosts Union in an ECAC matchup at Cheel Arena on Friday night.
items.why: Conference home game; Friday-night home games are the biggest regular draw on the local calendar.

items.headline: GriefShare session in Lisbon
items.what: A GriefShare support session meets in Lisbon on Thursday.
items.why: A recurring grief-support series that rotates through local churches.

items.enrichment: A vice-president-level vacancy. The follow-up to watch is a named successor or an interim appointment.
items.headline: Clarkson's VP for Information Technology & Libraries seat is vacant
items.what: Clarkson's Vice President for Information Technology & Libraries seat is vacant following Joshua Fiske's removal. No successor or interim has been named.
items.why: A vice-presidential departure touches every system on campus — IT, library, and the services staff use daily. The open seat is the story until an interim is named.

items.enrichment: Construction milestone at the campus's athletics and recreation hub.
items.headline: Maxcy Hall renovations nearing completion at SUNY Potsdam
items.what: Renovations at Maxcy Hall, SUNY Potsdam's athletics and recreation hub, are nearing completion.
items.why: Maxcy is the campus's main gym and pool complex; its reopening restores a facility the public uses as well as students.

items.enrichment: Reported by the university; the garden is open to the public.
items.headline: WISER Botanical Garden opens at SUNY Potsdam
items.what: The WISER Botanical Garden has opened at SUNY Potsdam, a new teaching and public garden space on campus.
items.why: A new public-facing campus space — part teaching garden, part community amenity.

items.enrichment: Hearing notices and any site work are the next developments to watch.
items.headline: Solar array proposed for 599 Bagdad Road, Potsdam
items.what: A solar array project is proposed for 599 Bagdad Road in Potsdam. The Village of Potsdam Board of Trustees has discussed proposed PILOT agreements with the developers of the $42–51 million project.
items.who: Village of Potsdam Board of Trustees; project developers
items.why: A project of this size means construction traffic, a tax-agreement decision by the village, and a visible land-use change on a residential road.

items.enrichment: The closest skiing to Potsdam. Opening date and open-terrain count are still to come in the hill's early-season reports.
items.headline: Titus Mountain begins posting trail reports ahead of opening
items.what: Titus Mountain has started publishing daily trail and lift reports ahead of its season opening — the first of the area's ski hills to do so this year.
items.why: Trail reports are the season's first hard signal for winter tourism in the northern county; lodging, rentals, and weekend traffic follow within weeks.
